svg.title: About Me and Life Beyond Code
svg.desc: Two cards. About Me: a frontend-focused software engineer with production experience in responsive UI, JavaScript and Node.js applications and enterprise platforms. Life Beyond Code: a rotating carousel of hobbies - games, anime, food, cycling and chess - with animated gradient tabs.
svg.text: I'm a frontend-focused software engineer who likes

Next.js, Redux, Tailwind and Vite skills through hands-on

g.text: Unwinding with a controller in hand
and always up for one more level.
Stories and worlds to get lost in,
Always up for a good meal
a clear head after the screen time.
on the board and off it.
